units.title: Particles and materials
units.why: Particle models explain properties and changes of materials.
principles: changes of state conserve substance identity
examples: heating ice increases particle energy until melting
gas pressure changes when particle collisions change
misconceptions: particles expand when heated rather than spacing changing
solutions: net movement from high to low concentration

videoPackage.title: Particles and materials
videoPackage.transcript: We use a particle model to explain states, changes of state, diffusion and pressure without changing the substance identity.

units.title: Energy transfer and work
units.why: Energy accounting connects machines, movement and efficiency.
misconceptions: energy is used up rather than transferred

videoPackage.title: Energy accounting
videoPackage.transcript: We track transfers through a system, calculate work and power with units, and report efficiency honestly.

units.title: Sound and electromagnetic radiation
units.why: Waves transfer energy and information through media and space.
examples: f=5 Hz and λ=2 m gives v=10 m/s
higher amplitude sound is perceived as louder
misconceptions: particles travel with a wave over its whole distance

videoPackage.title: Reading a wave
videoPackage.transcript: We label wavelength, frequency and amplitude, then apply the wave equation while keeping the medium assumptions visible.

units.title: Circuits and electrical safety
units.why: Circuit reasoning supports safe design and responsible energy use.
principles: charge flows in a closed circuit
examples: A fuse melts when current exceeds rating
misconceptions: current is consumed by a resistor

videoPackage.title: Safe circuit reasoning
videoPackage.transcript: We trace a closed path, define current and potential difference, calculate with Ohm's law, and identify safety controls.

units.title: Reactions and acids
units.why: Chemical change explains materials, reactions and safe everyday chemistry.
principles: coefficients balance equations without changing compounds
examples: acid plus base can neutralise to salt and water
misconceptions: changing subscripts to balance an equation

videoPackage.title: Reading chemical change
videoPackage.transcript: We track atoms as particles rearrange, balance with coefficients, and use pH and indicators safely.
